nodes.label: The committed PHP harnesses
nodes.rationale: There is no PHPUnit setup. The harnesses were previously kept in a session scratchpad and were lost, taking 143 assertions of regression cover with them on a plugin that deletes user media. That is why they are committed.

nodes.label: CLI PHP and web PHP have different extensions
nodes.rationale: CLI PHP has no Imagick, so every CLI harness exercises cwebp while the site itself runs Imagick. Never conclude an engine is unavailable from a CLI check - that reading produced a reported 'Imagick has never executed' finding that was wrong. Tracked as I-2 and covered by run.sh --web.
